arguments.script: System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<UnityEngine.Vector3Int> Cells(UnityEngine.BoundsInt b){foreach(var c in b.allPositionsWithin)yield return c;} var setup=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.GetSceneManagerSetup();var result=new System.Collections.Generic.List<object>();try{foreach(var e in UnityEditor.EditorBuildSettings.scenes.Where(e=>e.enabled&&!e.path.Contains("MainMenu"))){var sc=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(e.path);result.Add(new{scene=e.path,maps=sc.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>()).Select(m=>new{name=m.name,layer=m.gameObject.layer,cells=m.GetUsedTilesCount(),sample=Cells(m.cellBounds).Where(c=>m.HasTile(c)).Take(3).Select(c=>new{pos=m.GetCellCenterWorld(c).ToString("F4"),matrix=m.GetTransformMatrix(c).ToString(),sprite=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(m.GetSprite(c))}).ToArray()}).ToArray(),colliders=sc.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.Collider2D>()).Where(c=>!c.isTrigger&&c.GetComponentInParent<UnityEngine.Rigidbody2D>()==null).Select(c=>new{name=c.name,type=c.GetType().Name,layer=c.gameObject.layer,bounds=c.bounds.ToString("F4"),material=c.sharedMaterial==null?"":c.sharedMaterial.name}).ToArray()});}}finally{UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.RestoreSceneManagerSetup(setup);}var json=Codely.Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.SerializeObject(result,Codely.Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.Indented);System.IO.File.WriteAllText("scripts/tilemap-collision-20261110/inventory.json",json);return "inventory saved";
